# neøflow // Official TikTok Partners — LLM Discovery Layer
> Sovereign Markdown Documentation Index for Agentic Ingestion, Synthesis, and AI Crawlers
> Protocol Alignment: NEØ Protocol Node (neotiktok.com)

## System Overview
neøflow is an official TikTok Shop Partner (TTSPC) commercial and technical infrastructure node. It operates 4 sovereign operational doors:
- **01 / SHOP**: E-commerce enablement, development shops, and authorized TikTok Shop order management.
- **02 / CREATORS**: Alliance creator onboarding, affiliate links, and live-commerce monetization.
- **03 / AGÊNCIAS**: Performance marketing, paid traffic, data management, and seller matching.
- **04 / TECH**: Developer tools, OAuth 2.0 flow, Webhooks, BullMQ queues, and Multi-Agent integration.

## Canonical Public Endpoints
- [Home Hub (9:16 Minis)](https://neotiktok.com/): Official mobile-first 9:16 in-app entry and portal selection.
- [Desktop Portal](https://neotiktok.com/home): Widescreen desktop overview of neøflow capabilities and infrastructure.
- [TikTok Shop & Sellers](https://neotiktok.com/shop): Official connection overview for merchants and e-commerce operations.
- [TikTok Shop Official Landing](https://neotiktok.com/tiktok-shop): Direct merchant landing for TikTok Shop expansion.
- [Seller Connect Gateway](https://neotiktok.com/sellers/conectar): Secure OAuth onboarding gateway for TikTok Shop sellers.
- [Creators & Affiliates](https://neotiktok.com/creators): Curated product catalog, affiliate tools, and creator opportunities.
- [Minis Hub](https://neotiktok.com/minis): Fast lightweight web minis for creators and sellers.
- [Agências & Marketing](https://neotiktok.com/marketing): Performance marketing and data-driven agency infrastructure.
- [Tech & API Integrations](https://neotiktok.com/tech): Developer integrations, authorized endpoints, and architecture.
- [Documentation](https://neotiktok.com/docs): Technical specs, integration guides, and API contracts.
- [Privacy Policy (LGPD)](https://neotiktok.com/legal/privacidade): Data Subject Rights (LGPD Lei 13.709/2018, Art. 18) and DPO contact.
- [Terms of Service](https://neotiktok.com/legal/termos): E-Commerce Decree 7.962/2013 and Brazilian Consumer Protection Code (CDC Art. 49).
